crates.name: axon-encoder
crates.description: Flexible sensory encoding pipelines for spiking neural networks — rate, temporal, predictive, population, and neuromodulator-driven encoding for telemetry and cyber-physical data.

crates.name: corpus-ipc
crates.description: Spike and neuromodulator wire protocol and IPC transports for Limen-Neural SNN runtimes.

crates.name: engram-parser
crates.description: Pure-Rust GGUF + Safetensors checkpoint/tensor substrate: format-independent tensor inventory, metadata, and raw payload access for ANN/SNN research. Default builds are zero-dependency (`fs::read` into `Vec<u8>`). Optional `mmap` feature adds memmap2. Packed dequant for Q8_0/Q5_K/Q6_K/IQ3_M. Off-by-default `safetensors` feature adds manifest/discovery plus raw tensor payload access via the upstream safetensors crate. MoE per-expert weight extraction ships as a GGUF model-analysis specialization.

crates.name: kinetic-signals
crates.description: Streaming feature extraction for high-velocity stochastic signals.

crates.name: limbic-critic
crates.description: Reward-shaping / modulator-mapping primitive for SNNs (not a full actor-critic).

crates.name: myelin-accelerator
crates.description: Rust/CUDA acceleration primitives for spiking neural networks and neuromorphic workloads

crates.name: neuromod

crates.name: nir-rs
